artifacts.summary: 8-phase orphan-removal sweep: fresh baseline capture, 1 file+index-row removal, 4 stale-prose repair sites (one load-bearing, actively-injected doc with a preserved off-limits range), index-entries line_count restoration, a reusable on-demand deletion-reference detector, and a baseline-diff acceptance gate.

memory_candidates.content: When a repair pass edits a long document that discusses the same flag or mechanism in two different scopes (e.g. `--team` as a retired flag on /research vs. a live flag on /orchestrate), the plan must name an explicit PRESERVED line range and require a byte-identity diff of that range as a phase verification step, snapshotted before any edit. Naming only the edit sites is insufficient: the failure mode is the repairer over-generalizing from the defect to the adjacent correct passage, and a positive 'these lines must not change' assertion with a mechanical check is what catches it. Re-locate the preserved range by content anchors, not line numbers, since earlier edits shift them.
